SQ1.brief: Unreal Engine is the program you will use for every quest after this one. You do not download it from a website: you install a small program called the Epic Games Launcher, and the Launcher downloads the engine for you. The download is large, so start it when you have a good connection and some free disk space.
checklist: Download the Epic Games Launcher from Epic's website and install it. Open it and sign in with an Epic Games account (it is free to make one).
In the Launcher, click Unreal Engine in the left menu, then open the Library tab at the top. Click the + button next to Engine Versions and install the newest UE5 version it offers.
Before the download starts, click Options. Untick the platforms you will not build for, such as Android and iOS. This saves a lot of disk space, and you can add them back later.
When the install is finished, click Launch. Wait for the engine to open, and check that you see the Project Browser, the window where you pick or create a project.
SQ1.done_when: Send a screenshot of the Project Browser. The engine version number must be visible in it (you can see it in the window title or in the Launcher next to the engine).
